added.summary: A decal now marks the scattered copies (og.TerrainScatter), their far cards, a crowd's far cards and the grass (og.Grass) that stand in its box, as it marks a mesh and the terrain: a scorch mark or a painted zone no longer stops at the plants. A blade of grass takes the decal of the ground it stands on.

Snow, wetness and puddle gloss now lie on scattered copies (og.TerrainScatter), their far cards and a crowd's far cards as they lie on a mesh, so rocks and trees placed by scatter whiten and darken with the ground around them.
